data.name: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the most chaotic, yet utterly addictive "fully automated" farm in the universe.

Forget traditional management games where you manually swing hoes and herd livestock. Here, you have zero control over where the animals go—they sprint blindly across the field like wild horses. Your core mission is to use deep strategy to shape the environment, then sit back and watch the chaos trigger mind-blowing chain reactions!

This is a hardcore Roguelike strategy game that perfectly blends RNG, spatial geometry, and god-tier build synergy. You handle the probabilities and placement—the rest is up to fate and the animals' digestive tracts!

🎲 Master the Chaos: Luck is a Skill, But Wisdom Rewrites Fate

  • Uncontrollable, Free-Roaming Pathing: When the animals turn, collide, or poop on the farmland is entirely up to their own "free will."

  • Manipulate Odds with Items: Having animals hit structures to trigger skills used to be purely up to fate. But as the run progresses, you can collect powerful items that drastically boost trigger rates. With the right build, you can turn random luck into a 100% guaranteed "inevitable chain reaction"!

📐 Geometric Placement: Build Your Own "Living Pinball Machine"

Animals walk with random path, but you can use field items to pave the way for them!

  • Trajectory Masters: Use over a dozen types of placeable farm items with turning and bouncing mechanics to precisely guide animal routes, forcing them to "release" resources at the exact right time and place.

  • High-Stakes Spatial Strategy: The placement order and layout of your devices make or break your run. A god-tier setup can cause rampaging animals to trigger endless chain reactions between structures, skyrocketing your production efficiency in an instant!

🏆 Insane "Synergies": No Single Meta, Only Game-Breaking Combos

  • A Pool of 100+ Mysterious Trinkets: Every run is an irreversible, randomized adventure. Hundreds of trinkets provide rule-bending passive abilities.

  • Dopamine-Fueled Builds: Will you go for the "Ultra-Speed Hyper-Bounce Build," the "100% Lucky Never-Miss Build," or the "Poop-Covered Production Blast Build"? The synergies between animals, items, and trinkets are endless, satisfying your ultimate craving for min-maxing and theorycrafting!

📊 Endless Replayability! Face Never-Before-Seen Chaotic Runs

  • 10 Quirky animals, each with unique and chaotic collision physics

  • 10+ types of placeable items to alter trajectories and create infinite chains

  • 100+ trinkets and items to rewrite probabilities and break stat caps

  • 7 distinct game modes, each requiring an entirely new tactical approach to break the game

  • 7 grueling difficulty tiers, tailor-made for roguelike players who love deep strategy
